description_excerpt: Job Description • Perform mechanical inspection and supervision works, including welding inspection, in accordance with client specifications, applicable standards and approved procedures. • Ensure all inspection activities meet contractual, technical, quality and safety requirements. • Support Industrial Services in maintaining market leadership through technical excellence, service quality and customer satisfaction. • Achieve agreed work volume targets for mechanical services in coordination with BU Head, Technical Manager and Project Manager. • Contribute to continuous business growth…
benefits: Competitive compensation package (including base salary and allowances);
Holiday bonuses for major public holidays and birthday gift;
Annual leaves: 18 days / year, sick leaves;
Full participation in social, health and unemployment insurance in accordance with Vietnamese Labor law;
